reasoning: 21.9（SA12）規定收音機有電源鍵且非 ICS 時，才顯示 Auto-On Radio 設定。這是兩個條件的合取（有電源鍵 AND 非 ICS），故用決策表。兩個條件都是車輛／機型配置，屬 spec 明載的觸發條件，依 §8.5 exception 寫進 Pre-Condition。spec 未定義 ICS 一詞，也未規定不符條件時該設定是隱藏或變灰，故本筆只驗條件成立時「有顯示」這一格；條件不成立的反向格需要知道另一種機型的實際配置，本案輸入無法判定該配置是否存在於七款車型中，強行產生會落入 §8.4 的發明行為，故不生，缺口記於 ANOMALIES A-025 的同一模式。優先級：設定入口是否出現，訂 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本筆只驗條件成立時設定顯示；條件不成立的反向格因無法判定機型配置而不產生

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the Auto-On Radio setting when the radio has a power button and is not ICS.

(Radio with a power button and not ICS)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The radio in the vehicle has a power button
2. The radio is not an ICS radio
3. FM is the active source on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Audio" on the Tab Buttons to open the Audio Settings
3. Read the settings listed in the Audio Settings
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed
2. The Audio Settings are displayed in the Tab Area
3. An "Auto On Radio" setting is listed in the Audio Settings
